Gatekeeper and Argos exchange a series of letters negotiating the transfer of an individual held in Gatekeeper’s prison, but negotiations fall through and relations between the two gods turn sour.
Kushim battles Gatekeeper and barely survives, reclaiming the essence he lent to all of his champions in an act of self-preservation. 
All of Kushim’s champions die as a result of this – one of them being Zephyr’s husband.
Kushim becomes an avatar of Il’thli.
Kushim abandons the Iron Fist, which becomes radicalized into wanting to kill all gods – irregardless of nature or morality.
Solomon is killed by Zephyr for his cowardice and weakness.
Helios is killed by Zephyr for betraying the Iron Fist.
Zephyr commits suicide, cursing her bloodline to hunt down Kushim for eternity.
Magtanggol becomes the new leader of The Iron Fist, remaining in power up to the present day.
Gatekeeper is assassinated by one of his own followers (secretly an agent of the Iron Fist). Kei’ remakes him into a symbiotic cloak that can imbue beings with a portion of his powers and personality, and he is reborn as The Keymaster. 
Blanche, searching through The Keymaster’s memories from the future, discovers this and confronts Kei’. Azel’kyra intervenes and convinces Kei’ into a compromise that The Keymaster would eventually learn of his true nature.
The Allseer is killed by the Iron Fist, crushed beneath the ruins of the Panopticon.
Stagnant Age (End of Lost Era - 2000 AD)
Claudius is reborn as The Red Knight, Augustus is reborn as Icarus Procidens, and Gudang is reborn as Nostalgi Gaius.
SHALTOKOL embraces the corruption of The Backrooms, vowing revenge against the Red Knight for killing Augustus and (indirectly) Gudang.
The Muralist paints in solitude, eventually forgetting about Gudang. At some point, she ascends from a champion to an avatar of Ka’rot.
Argos kills Atlas, who returns in two parts: Lorenzo Windsor and The King.
A human named Paris falls into the Backrooms. He searches for a way out, before falling into Terminus’ domain and enduring unspeakable torture. 
Blanche rescues Paris, bringing him into the Cygnus Archive. Unbeknownst to them, however, is that he is now an avatar of Terminus: the Pillar Scribe.
A young Penumbra named Lunis is adopted by The Dark Sovereign after fleeing his home.
Upon reaching adulthood, Lunis becomes “Obscura”, a champion of The Dark Sovereign.
Obscura battles The Dark Sovereign, ending with his banishment from Level 197 and being cursed to never speak again.
Berry, Blanche’s pet cat, witnesses the Beyond and gains powers – causing a cult to form around him.
1800s – a Faceling later known as “The Alchemist” becomes an avatar of Scieph’rya.
Philia meets The Alchemist
1920s – Two sisters named Penelope and Diana Ludumson fall into The Backrooms.
Mother transforms Diana into an entity known as “The Dollmaker”
Penelope dies and The Dollmaker attempts to revive her by constructing a new puppet body for her. However, she does not have the power to resurrect her.
Dandizette takes notice of this and decides to lend help, transferring Penelope’s soul into the puppet while making her their champion in doing so.
Penelope, now known as “The Game Master”, is imprisoned in Level 389. She later eventually becomes an avatar of Komo’oide herself.
A puzzle box no-clips into Level 236.
After many years, the puzzle box becomes an avatar of Komo’oide, in the form of a nameless creature made of puzzles. The being becomes conscious and transforms the nameless level into its own home.
The puzzle creature assigns itself forms and begins contact with humans, it is avoided and feared due to its incomprehensible shape and its confusing level.
The puzzle creature begins studying humans through the objects in its level. It begins to assume a more humanoid form, create an identity for itself, and perfect the art of humor and puzzle-making to entertain others. Thus, he gives himself the title of Puzzle Maker.
Puzzle Maker lives in his level, having frequent contact with humans, and attempting to research his origins.
April 26, 1978 – Victor Summerton is born in Boulder City, Nevada.
1979 – Isabella Medina is born in Santa Rosa, New Mexico.
The Painter enters level 57, becoming a champion of The Muralist.
May 27, 1980 – Brian Smith is born in Oshkosh, Wisconsin.
A wearer of The Keymaster’s cloak is terminated by The Iron Fist, and his body is dissected for research. However, a faint trace of The Keymaster’s essence lingers within the brain, keeping it barely alive and preserved.
1994 – Victor Summerton falls into The Backrooms, writing his experiences in a journal.
January 5, 1995 – Justin Rivers is born in Canada.
June 28, 1995 – Callum Andrews is born in The Backrooms.
September 18, 1995 – Andrew Donovan is born in Canada.
1996 –  Olivia Bellerose is born in Lyons, France.
March 8, 1996 – Katherine Rivers is born in Canada.
1997 – Victor Summerton becomes “The Game Player”, a champion of The Game Master, and creates his own domain within Level 389.

Liminal Era (2000 AD - Present Day)
Tom Von Haderach appears within the Cygnus Archive, and Blanche raises him as a son.
2008 - Olivia Bellerose enters the Backrooms
2012 – Justin Rivers, Katherine Rivers, and Andrew Donovan found The Major Explorer Group (M.E.G.).
October 1, 2013 – Following the death of his parents in an entity attack, Callum Andrews journeys beyond his home on Level 2 in search of purpose.
2014 – Brian Smith falls into The Backrooms, and becomes the current wearer of The Keymaster’s cloak.
The Iron Fist undergoes a change of leadership in four of its fingers. 
Amadeus Ludwig Steele becomes the new premier of the Mars Finger (Publicly known as “The Unbound Explorer’s Coalition (U.E.C.)”)
Abdias Podhortzer becomes the new premier of the Jupiter Finger.
Alistair “Yellow” Edford becomes the new premier of the Sol Finger (Publicly known as “Backrooms Robotics”).
Joan Arteaga becomes the new premier of the Mercury Finger.
January 9, 2015 – Callum joins the Backrooms Nonaligned Trade Group (B.N.T.G.).
March 18, 2016 – Isabella Medina discovers the Memoriter and becomes bound to The Grifter. She is found by the M.E.G., subsequently joining the group. 
2017 – Callum is fired from the B.N.T.G. for embezzling assets.
Mid-January, 2017 – Isabella’s physical health and mental state seemingly begins deteriorating as a result of her link to The Grifter.
March 9, 2017 – Isabella is interviewed by the M.E.G. regarding recent incidents in which she seems to be possessed by The Grifter.
M.E.G. operative Jacob Howard is imprisoned by The Keymaster in Level HELP.
2020 – Callum joins Backrooms Robotics.
A B.N.T.G. expedition in Level 51 uncovers the fossilized remains of a sacred medicinal flower associated with Gudang in ancient times. The flower is reverse-engineered and synthesized into a drug, which unfortunately becomes abused for its memory-altering side effects and circulated on the black market.
April 13, 2020 – Level 389.9 and The Game Player are discovered/documented by the M.E.G.
The Keymaster fights The Game Master.
Berry returns to Blanche, prompting the Visionaries of Berry to search for him.
Ethan Nelson becomes “The Cultivator”, a champion of Protastheia.
The Keymaster and the Red Knight fight in Level 11.
In the aftermath of the battle, four human children are exposed to the Red Knight’s spilled blood – becoming a group of champions known as The Squires.
SHALTOKOL creates The Heralds of Rust. 
The preserved brain of the previous Keymaster is used to create the Hermes Device.
M.E.G. researcher Gavriel White develops an addiction to Strange Pills while attempting to study their effects. She is lured into Level 404 by Nostalgi Gaius, subsequently dying of mysterious causes.
Aelita River discovers Nostalgi Gaius and merges with her.
Eden G discovers Icarus.
River disappears into Level 404, hir merging with Gaius progressing further as they wrestle for control.
Blanche reunites with Nostalgi Gaius, although not on the best of terms.
Eden takes it upon herself to search for River. Icarus approaches her with an offer which she ultimately rejects, traveling to level 404 alone. She is officially declared “K.I.A.” on-record, though the M.E.G.’s overseers know her true fate of becoming Nostalgi Gaius’ champion.
The Keymaster reunites with Blanche, who searches his memory and reveals his origins to him.
February 6, 2021 – Blanche is interviewed by M.E.G. operative Dawn Marchesa. Her entity article is subsequently written in-universe.
Icarus intrudes the Cygnus Archive and harrasses Blanche and Tom, attempting to provoke her.
June 26, 2021 — Callum Andrews is officially pardoned by the B.N.T.G. for his past actions.
The Red Knight reunites with Nostalgi Gaius and Icarus.
The Keymaster falls into Level 404 and encounters Nostalgi Gaius. Gaius and River complete their merging into an entirely new being known as “Symmetria”, who helps wanderers rather than preying on them.
Within The Broken, Gudang’s carved-out memories form into an individual being known as “Anemoi Syne”.
The Red Knight saves an M.E.G. archivist named Emilie Langerman.
Anemoi Syne merges with Eden G.
January 13, 2022 - Aster is reborn
January 18, 2022 - Entity 405 is consumed by Null-06.
January 19, 2022 - Null-06 unleashes a massive energy wave which destroys most of the devices in Level 78’s space station.
January 27, 2022 - Level 78’s space station collides with Blip-03, otherwise known as Ad Astra — an event which Solaris fails to stop.
Y’liad Elyion returns from Greyrealm after conquering and annihilating all life within it, leaving him with no purpose to fulfill as he comes to the realization that he will never be able to truly embody his role as an avatar of Stupor. He thus “retires” from said role and begins wandering the backrooms to see what has changed.
Y’liad meets Olivia Bellerose.
A stray house cat bites off a piece of The Keymaster’s cloak, becoming The Catmaster.
The Keymaster of the Convergence universe crosses over into this universe. With help from the Keymaster of this universe, he eventually returns to his native universe — thus preventing an interdimensional catastrophe (and retribution from the Time Keepers).
Meanwhile, The Game Master is telepathically contacted by The Jester for help, but she instead ridicules him.
Giorgion Arachne reawakens.
August 25, 2023 – Allistair Edford passes away. Callum Andrews, AKA “White Sun”, becomes the new CEO – and the new leader of the Sol Finger.
The Keymaster reunites with Philia, who restores the rest of his memories as Gatekeeper.
A child faceling named Maria becomes a champion of The Alchemist.
A.I.D.E.N. is manufactured by Backrooms Robotics
December 24, 2023 -  The Keymaster learns the true meaning of Christmas.
Kirai forms a permanent host for himself.
The horned Keymaster (Kei’s first avatar) flees to The Middlesorts, before taking refuge in the Convergence universe.
May 12, 2024 - The events of Sins of The Father transpire.
A U.E.C. squad raids Castle Crey to confront the horned Keymaster, but they are all massacred by him.
The Keymaster eventually confronts his counterpart, only to be quickly defeated and separated from his cloak.
The Keymaster reawakens in Level 0 as Brian Smith, forced to survive The Backrooms as a normal human.
After being rescued by the M.E.G., Brian visits the Cygnus Archive to seek help from Blanche. She informs him of The Keymaster’s true nature as an avatar of Kei’, before attempting to arrange a meeting with other avatars at his request in order to seek help from them as well. 
The other avatars refuse to help Brian, leaving him demoralized. However, Philia then steps in to help him. Brian and Philia infiltrate an Iron Fist base to steal the Hermes Device, before going their separate ways.
Brian attempts to use the Hermes Device to locate the horned Keymaster, only to find that he has already left this universe. After being chased down by a feral Penumbra, Brian flees back to the Cygnus Archive.
Blanche directs Brian to venture deeper into the Cygnus Archive, leading him into the Level 906 of the Convergence universe where he meets The Storyteller.
Brian finds The Alchemist and Philia, who help him regain a portion of his Keymaster powers by ingesting Adrian Waxillium’s champion essence.
Brian enters The Middlesorts, enlisting the help of the Corpus Cores to track down the horned Keymaster. He is teleported to the horned Keymaster’s location, only to be imprisoned alongside the souls of every other keymaster in every reality.
Brian reunites with the Convergence Keymaster and with Gatekeeper. The Catmaster frees Brian and he merges with Gatekeeper, becoming The Keymaster once again. 
All of the Keymasters break out of the prison and confront the horned Keymaster, battling him across every reality.
Eventually, the horned Keymaster finds Kei’s seal within Level 0, breaking it to complete his mission of setting Kei’ free. Kei’ rewards the horned Keymaster by killing him.
Kei’ is confronted by other Pillars, being forced to undo all the damage done in exchange for not being imprisoned again.
Brian reawakens in The Frontrooms, where the year is still 2014 and he had been comatose for only 3 days.
The Alchemist revives The Keymaster as an independent being by combining his cloak with the Hermes Device and Catmaster.
The Keymaster reunites with Solaris, discovering that they in fact have two daughters together.
The horned Keymaster respawns within “You Cheated”, where other cosmic criminals such as The Officinarum and Noire are imprisoned. He eventually escapes, instead being bound to indentured servitude as a receptionist in The Middlesorts.
The Crimson Emissary visits The Middlesorts, returning the horned Keymaster’s wife and daughter as a “gift”.
The Dreamwalker enters this universe
May 29, 2024 - The real-life location of the original Backrooms photo is discovered.
The Corpus Cores attempt to perform damage control in the aftermath of Sins of The Father, in order to avoid scrutiny from The Staff. They employ Backrooms Remodeling Co. to repair damages done to Level 0, only to find that Baughust has reawoken.
Argos and The Red Knight work together to battle The Memory Wyrm
